summary: Ambev S.A. filed a Form 6-K reporting share repurchase transactions during May 2026, including open-market purchases via Santander totaling R$ 48–50 million per day at prices from R$ 15.73 to R$ 16.87 per share. The company also acquired shares directly through delivery of restricted shares and option exercises. The filing satisfies Brazilian CVM Instruction #44/2021 disclosure requirements. As a foreign private issuer, this equates to a US issuer's periodic share buyback report. No board recommendation, advisor, or premium is stated. Watch for ongoing buyback pace and any acceleration; no arbitrage angle exists as this is a routine capital return activity.
